examples.name: c01-orders.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT o.SalesOrderID,
       o.OrderDate,
       COUNT(l.SalesOrderLineID) AS Lines,
       ROUND(SUM(l.LineTotal),2) AS OrderedLines
FROM SalesOrder o
JOIN SalesOrderLine l ON l.SalesOrderID=o.SalesOrderID
WHERE o.SalesOrderID IN (SELECT SalesOrderID
FROM SalesOrder
WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01')
GROUP BY o.SalesOrderID,o.OrderDate
ORDER BY o.OrderDate,o.SalesOrderID;

examples.name: c01-fulfillment.sql
examples.sql:
WITH shipped AS (SELECT sl.SalesOrderLineID,
       SUM(sl.QuantityShipped) AS Shipped
FROM ShipmentLine sl
JOIN Shipment s ON s.ShipmentID=sl.ShipmentID
WHERE s.ShipmentDate<='2024-03-31'
GROUP BY sl.SalesOrderLineID), billed AS (SELECT il.SalesOrderLineID,
       SUM(il.Quantity) AS Billed
FROM SalesInvoiceLine il
JOIN SalesInvoice i ON i.SalesInvoiceID=il.SalesInvoiceID
WHERE i.InvoiceDate<='2024-03-31'
GROUP BY il.SalesOrderLineID) SELECT l.SalesOrderID,
       l.SalesOrderLineID,
       l.Quantity AS Ordered,
       COALESCE(s.Shipped,0) AS Shipped,
       COALESCE(b.Billed,0) AS Billed
FROM SalesOrderLine l
LEFT JOIN shipped s ON s.SalesOrderLineID=l.SalesOrderLineID
LEFT JOIN billed b ON b.SalesOrderLineID=l.SalesOrderLineID
WHERE l.SalesOrderID IN (SELECT SalesOrderID
FROM SalesOrder
WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01')
ORDER BY l.SalesOrderID,l.LineNumber;

examples.name: c01-invoices.sql

examples.name: c01-applications.sql
examples.sql:

FROM SalesInvoice
WHERE SalesOrderID IN (SELECT SalesOrderID

examples.name: c01-credits.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT CreditMemoID,
       CreditMemoDate,
       SalesOrderID,
       OriginalSalesInvoiceID,
       GrandTotal
FROM CreditMemo
WHERE SalesOrderID IN (SELECT SalesOrderID
FROM SalesOrder
WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01') OR OriginalSalesInvoiceID IN (SELECT SalesInvoiceID

examples.name: c01-balances.sql
examples.sql:
WITH cutoffs(AsOf) AS (VALUES('2024-03-31'),('2024-04-30')) SELECT d.AsOf,
       i.SalesInvoiceID,
       i.GrandTotal,
       ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.AppliedAmount)
FROM CashReceiptApplication a
WHERE a.SalesInvoiceID=i.SalesInvoiceID AND a.ApplicationDate<=d.AsOf),0),2) AS Applied,
       ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.GrandTotal)
FROM CreditMemo c
WHERE c.OriginalSalesInvoiceID=i.SalesInvoiceID AND c.CreditMemoDate<=d.AsOf),0),2) AS Credited,
       ROUND(i.GrandTotal-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.AppliedAmount)
FROM CashReceiptApplication a
WHERE a.SalesInvoiceID=i.SalesInvoiceID AND a.ApplicationDate<=d.AsOf),0)-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.GrandTotal)
FROM CreditMemo c
WHERE c.OriginalSalesInvoiceID=i.SalesInvoiceID AND c.CreditMemoDate<=d.AsOf),0),2) AS Remaining
FROM cutoffs d CROSS
JOIN SalesInvoice i
WHERE i.SalesOrderID IN (SELECT SalesOrderID
FROM SalesOrder
WHERE CustomerID=120 AND OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2024-04-01') AND i.InvoiceDate<=d.AsOf
ORDER BY d.AsOf,i.SalesInvoiceID;

examples.name: c01-ledger.sql

examples.name: c02-time.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT ServiceEngagementID,
       substr(WorkDate,1,7) AS WorkMonth,
       COUNT(*) AS Entries,
       ROUND(SUM(BillableHours),2) AS BillableHours,
       ROUND(SUM(NonBillableHours),2) AS NonBillableHours,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ApprovedDate<='2024-03-31' THEN BillableHours ELSE 0 END),2) AS ApprovedBillable,
       ROUND(SUM(ExtendedCost),2) AS RecordedTimeCost
FROM ServiceTimeEntry
WHERE WorkDate>='2024-01-01' AND WorkDate<'2024-04-01'
GROUP BY ServiceEngagementID,substr(WorkDate,1,7)
ORDER BY ServiceEngagementID,WorkMonth;

examples.name: c02-cutoff.sql
examples.sql:

       COUNT(DISTINCT ServiceEngagementID) AS Engagements,
       ROUND(SUM(BillableHours),2) AS BillableHours,
       ROUND(SUM(NonBillableHours),2) AS NonBillableHours,
       ROUND(SUM(ExtendedCost),2) AS TimeCost,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ApprovedDate IS NULL OR ApprovedDate>'2024-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NotApprovedAtCutoff
FROM ServiceTimeEntry
WHERE WorkDate>='2024-01-01' AND WorkDate<'2024-04-01';

examples.name: c02-billing.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT b.ServiceBillingLineID,
       b.ServiceEngagementID,
       b.BillingPeriodStartDate,
       b.BillingPeriodEndDate,
       b.BilledHours,
       b.LineAmount,
       i.SalesInvoiceID,
       i.InvoiceDate,
       ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.BillableHours)
FROM ServiceTimeEntry t
WHERE t.ServiceEngagementID=b.ServiceEngagementID AND t.WorkDate BETWEEN b.BillingPeriodStartDate AND b.BillingPeriodEndDate AND t.ApprovedDate<=i.InvoiceDate),0),2) AS HoursApprovedByInvoice
FROM ServiceBillingLine b
JOIN SalesInvoiceLine l ON l.SalesInvoiceLineID=b.SalesInvoiceLineID
JOIN SalesInvoice i ON i.SalesInvoiceID=l.SalesInvoiceID
WHERE b.BillingPeriodStartDate>='2024-01-01' AND b.BillingPeriodEndDate<'2024-04-01'
ORDER BY b.ServiceEngagementID,b.BillingPeriodStartDate,b.ServiceBillingLineID;

examples.name: c02-bridge.sql
examples.sql:
WITH effort AS (SELECT SUM(BillableHours) AS Billable,
       SUM(NonBillableHours) AS NonBillable,
       SUM(ExtendedCost) AS TimeCost
FROM ServiceTimeEntry
WHERE WorkDate>='2024-01-01' AND WorkDate<'2024-04-01'), billing AS (SELECT SUM(LineAmount) AS Billed
FROM ServiceBillingLine
WHERE BillingPeriodStartDate>='2024-01-01' AND BillingPeriodEndDate<'2024-04-01') SELECT ROUND(e.Billable,2) AS BillableHours,
       ROUND(e.NonBillable,2) AS NonBillableHours,
       ROUND(100.0*e.Billable/(e.Billable+e.NonBillable),2) AS BillableSharePct,
       ROUND(b.Billed,2) AS BilledAmount,
       ROUND(e.TimeCost,2) AS RecordedTimeCost,
       ROUND(b.Billed-e.TimeCost,2) AS BilledLessTimeCost
FROM effort e CROSS
JOIN billing b;

examples.name: c03-goods-balances.sql
examples.sql:
WITH cutoffs(AsOf) AS (VALUES('2024-03-31'),('2024-06-30')), events AS (SELECT g.PostingDate,
       a.AccountNumber,
       g.Credit-g.Debit AS LiabilityChange
FROM GLEntry g
JOIN Account a ON a.AccountID=g.AccountID
WHERE a.AccountNumber IN(2010,2020) AND ((g.SourceDocumentType='GoodsReceipt' AND g.SourceDocumentID IN(174,175,253,396,340)) OR (g.SourceDocumentType='PurchaseInvoice' AND g.SourceDocumentID IN(143,278,1499,179,422,614,947)) OR (g.SourceDocumentType='DisbursementPayment' AND g.SourceDocumentID IN(SELECT DisbursementID
FROM DisbursementPayment
WHERE PurchaseInvoiceID IN(143,278,1499,179,422,614,947))))) SELECT d.AsOf,
       e.AccountNumber,
       ROUND(SUM(e.LiabilityChange),2) AS SelectedLiability
FROM cutoffs d
JOIN events e ON e.PostingDate<=d.AsOf
GROUP BY d.AsOf,e.AccountNumber
ORDER BY d.AsOf,e.AccountNumber;

examples.name: c04-population.sql

SELECT COUNT(*) AS Lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.SalesInvoiceID) AS Invoices,
       ROUND(SUM(l.Quantity),2) AS Quantity,
       ROUND(SUM(l.LineTotal),2) AS InvoicedLines
FROM SalesInvoiceLine l

examples.name: c04-comparison.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT p.ItemGroup,
       COUNT(*) AS Lines,
       ROUND(SUM(l.Quantity),2) AS Quantity,
       ROUND(SUM(l.LineTotal),2) AS InvoicedLines,
       ROUND(SUM(l.Quantity*l.BaseListPrice),2) AS ListValue,
       ROUND(SUM(l.Quantity*p.StandardCost),2) AS CurrentStandardCost,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(l.LineTotal)/NULLIF(SUM(l.Quantity*l.BaseListPrice),0),2) AS RealizationPct,
       ROUND(SUM(l.LineTotal-l.Quantity*p.StandardCost),2) AS StandardMargin,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(l.LineTotal-l.Quantity*p.StandardCost)/NULLIF(SUM(l.LineTotal),0),2) AS StandardMarginPct
FROM SalesInvoiceLine l
JOIN SalesInvoice i ON i.SalesInvoiceID=l.SalesInvoiceID
JOIN Item p ON p.ItemID=l.ItemID
WHERE i.InvoiceDate>='2024-01-01' AND i.InvoiceDate<'2024-04-01' AND p.ItemType='Finished Good'
GROUP BY p.ItemGroup
ORDER BY StandardMarginPct,p.ItemGroup;

examples.name: c05-costs.sql
examples.sql:
WITH issues AS (SELECT h.WorkOrderID,
       SUM(l.ExtendedStandardCost) AS Issued
FROM MaterialIssue h
JOIN MaterialIssueLine l ON l.MaterialIssueID=h.MaterialIssueID
WHERE h.IssueDate<='2024-02-29'
GROUP BY h.WorkOrderID), labor AS (SELECT WorkOrderID,
       SUM(ExtendedLaborCost) AS LaborSupport
FROM LaborTimeEntry
WHERE WorkDate<='2024-02-29'
GROUP BY WorkOrderID), completions AS (SELECT h.WorkOrderID,
       SUM(l.QuantityCompleted) AS CompletedQty,
       SUM(l.ExtendedStandardMaterialCost) AS CompletedMaterials,
       SUM(l.ExtendedStandardConversionCost) AS CompletedConversion,
       SUM(l.ExtendedStandardTotalCost) AS CompletedTotal
FROM ProductionCompletion h
JOIN ProductionCompletionLine l ON l.ProductionCompletionID=h.ProductionCompletionID
WHERE h.CompletionDate<='2024-02-29'
GROUP BY h.WorkOrderID), closes AS (SELECT WorkOrderID,
       SUM(MaterialVarianceAmount) AS MaterialVariance,
       SUM(ConversionVarianceAmount) AS ConversionVariance,
       SUM(TotalVarianceAmount) AS TotalVariance
FROM WorkOrderClose
WHERE CloseDate<='2024-02-29'
GROUP BY WorkOrderID) SELECT w.WorkOrderID,
       ROUND(COALESCE(i.Issued,0),2) AS Issued,
       ROUND(COALESCE(l.LaborSupport,0),2) AS LaborSupport,
       ROUND(COALESCE(c.CompletedQty,0),2) AS CompletedQty,
       ROUND(COALESCE(c.CompletedMaterials,0),2) AS CompletedMaterials,
       ROUND(COALESCE(c.CompletedConversion,0),2) AS CompletedConversion,
       ROUND(COALESCE(c.CompletedTotal,0),2) AS CompletedTotal,
       x.MaterialVariance,
       x.ConversionVariance,
       x.TotalVariance
FROM WorkOrder w
LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.WorkOrderID=w.WorkOrderID
LEFT JOIN labor l ON l.WorkOrderID=w.WorkOrderID
LEFT JOIN completions c ON c.WorkOrderID=w.WorkOrderID
LEFT JOIN closes x ON x.WorkOrderID=w.WorkOrderID
WHERE w.ReleasedDate>='2024-01-01' AND w.ReleasedDate<'2024-02-01'
ORDER BY w.WorkOrderID;

examples.sql:

       SUM(ConversionVarianceAmount) AS ConversionVariance,
       SUM(TotalVarianceAmount) AS TotalVariance
FROM WorkOrderClose

GROUP BY WorkOrderID) SELECT w.WorkOrderID,
       ROUND(COALESCE(i.Issued,0),2) AS Issued,
       ROUND(COALESCE(l.LaborSupport,0),2) AS LaborSupport,
       ROUND(COALESCE(c.CompletedQty,0),2) AS CompletedQty,

       ROUND(COALESCE(c.CompletedConversion,0),2) AS CompletedConversion,

LEFT JOIN closes x ON x.WorkOrderID=w.WorkOrderID
WHERE w.ReleasedDate>='2024-01-01' AND w.ReleasedDate<'2024-02-01' AND w.WorkOrderID IN(1,67)
ORDER BY w.WorkOrderID;

examples.name: c05-capacity.sql
examples.sql:
WITH load AS (SELECT WorkCenterID,
       ScheduleDate,
       SUM(ScheduledHours) AS Hours
FROM WorkOrderOperationSchedule
WHERE ScheduleDate>='2024-01-01' AND ScheduleDate<='2024-02-29'
GROUP BY WorkCenterID,ScheduleDate) SELECT c.WorkCenterID,
       ROUND(SUM(c.AvailableHours),2) AS AvailableHours,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(l.Hours,0)),2) AS ScheduledHours,
       SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.Hours,0)>c.AvailableHours THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DaysAboveCapacity
FROM WorkCenterCalendar c
LEFT JOIN load l ON l.WorkCenterID=c.WorkCenterID AND l.ScheduleDate=c.CalendarDate
WHERE c.CalendarDate>='2024-01-01' AND c.CalendarDate<='2024-02-29'
GROUP BY c.WorkCenterID
ORDER BY c.WorkCenterID;

examples.name: c05-planning.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT s.SupplyPlanRecommendationID,
       s.ItemID,
       s.WarehouseID,
       s.BucketWeekStartDate,
       s.BucketWeekEndDate,
       s.DriverType,
       s.GrossRequirementQuantity,
       s.ProjectedAvailableQuantity,
       s.RecommendedOrderQuantity,
       s.NeedByDate,
       s.ReleaseByDate,
       f.DemandForecastID,
       f.ForecastQuantity,
       f.ApprovedDate
FROM SupplyPlanRecommendation s
LEFT JOIN DemandForecast f ON f.ItemID=s.ItemID AND f.WarehouseID=s.WarehouseID AND f.ForecastWeekStartDate=s.BucketWeekStartDate AND f.IsCurrent=1
WHERE s.SupplyPlanRecommendationID=777
ORDER BY f.DemandForecastID;

examples.name: c06-coverage.sql
examples.sql:
WITH roster AS (SELECT WorkCenterID,
       SUM(ScheduledHours) AS PlannedPresence
FROM EmployeeShiftRoster
WHERE RosterDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-28' AND RosterStatus IN ('Scheduled','Reassigned')
GROUP BY WorkCenterID), load AS (SELECT WorkCenterID,
       SUM(ScheduledHours) AS PlannedLoad
FROM WorkOrderOperationSchedule
WHERE ScheduleDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-28'
GROUP BY WorkCenterID), worked AS (SELECT WorkCenterID,
       SUM(RegularHours) AS Regular,
       SUM(OvertimeHours) AS Overtime
FROM TimeClockEntry
WHERE WorkDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-28' AND PayrollPeriodID IN (1,2) AND ClockStatus='Approved'
GROUP BY WorkCenterID) SELECT c.WorkCenterID,
       c.WorkCenterName,
       ROUND(COALESCE(r.PlannedPresence,0),2) AS RosteredHours,
       ROUND(COALESCE(l.PlannedLoad,0),2) AS OperationHours,
       ROUND(COALESCE(w.Regular,0),2) AS RegularHours,
       ROUND(COALESCE(w.Overtime,0),2) AS OvertimeHours
FROM WorkCenter c
LEFT JOIN roster r ON r.WorkCenterID=c.WorkCenterID
LEFT JOIN load l ON l.WorkCenterID=c.WorkCenterID
LEFT JOIN worked w ON w.WorkCenterID=c.WorkCenterID
ORDER BY c.WorkCenterID;

examples.name: c06-absence.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT r.WorkCenterID,
       COUNT(*) AS Absences,
       ROUND(SUM(a.HoursAbsent),2) AS AbsentHours
FROM EmployeeAbsence a
JOIN EmployeeShiftRoster r ON r.EmployeeShiftRosterID=a.EmployeeShiftRosterID
WHERE a.AbsenceDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-28'
GROUP BY r.WorkCenterID
ORDER BY r.WorkCenterID;

examples.name: c06-pay.sql
examples.sql:
WITH hours AS (SELECT EmployeeID,
       PayrollPeriodID,
       SUM(RegularHours) AS Regular,
       SUM(OvertimeHours) AS Overtime,
       COUNT(DISTINCT WorkCenterID) AS WorkCenters
FROM TimeClockEntry
WHERE PayrollPeriodID IN(1,2) AND WorkDate BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-01-28' AND ClockStatus='Approved'
GROUP BY EmployeeID,PayrollPeriodID) SELECT p.PayrollRegisterID,
       p.EmployeeID,
       p.PayrollPeriodID,
       ROUND(h.Regular,2) AS RegularHours,
       ROUND(h.Overtime,2) AS OvertimeHours,
       h.WorkCenters,
       p.GrossPay,
       p.EmployeeWithholdings,
       p.NetPay,
       p.EmployerPayrollTax,
       p.EmployerBenefits
FROM PayrollRegister p
LEFT JOIN hours h ON h.EmployeeID=p.EmployeeID AND h.PayrollPeriodID=p.PayrollPeriodID
WHERE p.PayrollPeriodID IN (1,2)
ORDER BY p.EmployeeID,p.PayrollPeriodID;

examples.name: c06-pay-summary.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT PayrollPeriodID,
       COUNT(*) AS Registers,
       ROUND(SUM(GrossPay),2) AS GrossPay,
       ROUND(SUM(EmployeeWithholdings),2) AS Withholdings,
       ROUND(SUM(NetPay),2) AS NetPay,
       ROUND(SUM(EmployerPayrollTax),2) AS EmployerTax,
       ROUND(SUM(EmployerBenefits),2) AS Benefits
FROM PayrollRegister
WHERE PayrollPeriodID IN(1,2)
GROUP BY PayrollPeriodID
ORDER BY PayrollPeriodID;

examples.name: c06-employee-lines.sql

examples.name: c06-payments.sql

examples.name: c06-unpaid.sql

examples.name: c07-rollforward.sql

SELECT a.AccountNumber,

       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.PostingDate>='2026-10-01' THEN g.Debit-g.Credit ELSE 0 END),2) AS QuarterDebitNet,
       ROUND(SUM(g.Debit-g.Credit),2) AS ClosingDebitNet
FROM GLEntry g
JOIN Account a ON a.AccountID=g.AccountID

examples.name: c07-bridge.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT a.AccountNumber,
       a.AccountName,
       ROUND(-SUM(g.Debit-g.Credit),2) AS BridgeEffect
FROM GLEntry g
JOIN Account a ON a.AccountID=g.AccountID
LEFT JOIN JournalEntry j ON g.SourceDocumentType='JournalEntry' AND j.JournalEntryID=g.SourceDocumentID
WHERE g.PostingDate BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-12-31' AND a.AccountNumber<>1010 AND a.AccountType NOT IN('Revenue','Expense') AND COALESCE(j.EntryType,'') NOT LIKE 'Year-End Close%'

examples.name: c08-populations.sql

examples.name: c08-duplicates.sql
examples.sql:
WITH groups AS (SELECT SupplierID,
       InvoiceNumber,
       COUNT(*) AS Occurrences
FROM PurchaseInvoice
GROUP BY SupplierID,InvoiceNumber
HAVING COUNT(*)>1) SELECT i.SupplierID,
       i.InvoiceNumber,
       i.PurchaseInvoiceID,
       i.InvoiceDate,
       i.GrandTotal,
       g.Occurrences,
       ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.Amount)
FROM DisbursementPayment p
WHERE p.PurchaseInvoiceID=i.PurchaseInvoiceID),0),2) AS Paid
FROM PurchaseInvoice i
JOIN groups g ON g.SupplierID=i.SupplierID AND g.InvoiceNumber=i.InvoiceNumber
ORDER BY i.SupplierID,i.InvoiceNumber,i.PurchaseInvoiceID;

examples.name: c08-checks.sql
examples.sql:
WITH groups AS (SELECT SupplierID,
       CheckNumber,
       COUNT(*) AS Occurrences
FROM DisbursementPayment
WHERE CheckNumber IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CheckNumber)<>''
GROUP BY SupplierID,CheckNumber
HAVING COUNT(*)>1) SELECT p.SupplierID,
       p.CheckNumber,
       p.DisbursementID,
       p.PurchaseInvoiceID,
       p.PaymentDate,
       p.Amount,
       p.ClearedDate,
       g.Occurrences
FROM DisbursementPayment p
JOIN groups g ON g.SupplierID=p.SupplierID AND g.CheckNumber=p.CheckNumber
ORDER BY p.SupplierID,p.CheckNumber,p.DisbursementID;

examples.name: c08-overtime.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT t.TimeClockEntryID,
       t.EmployeeID,
       t.PayrollPeriodID,
       t.WorkDate,
       t.OvertimeHours,
       t.OvertimeApprovalID,
       a.ApprovedHours,
       a.ApprovedDate,
       a.Status,
       CASE WHEN a.OvertimeApprovalID IS NULL THEN 'Missing linked approval' WHEN a.ApprovedHours<t.OvertimeHours THEN 'Hours exceed approval' ELSE 'Hours supported' END AS HoursTest
FROM TimeClockEntry t
LEFT JOIN OvertimeApproval a ON a.OvertimeApprovalID=t.OvertimeApprovalID
WHERE t.WorkDate>='2026-10-01' AND t.WorkDate<'2027-01-01' AND t.ClockStatus='Approved' AND t.OvertimeHours>0
ORDER BY t.WorkDate,t.TimeClockEntryID;

examples.name: c08-compare.sql
examples.sql:
SELECT t.TimeClockEntryID,
       t.EmployeeID,
       t.PayrollPeriodID,
       t.WorkDate,
       t.OvertimeHours,
       t.ApprovedDate AS TimeApprovedDate,
       t.OvertimeApprovalID,
       a.EmployeeID AS ApprovalEmployeeID,
       a.PayrollPeriodID AS ApprovalPeriodID,
       a.WorkDate AS ApprovalWorkDate,
       a.ApprovedHours,
       a.ApprovedDate AS OvertimeApprovedDate,
       a.Status
FROM TimeClockEntry t
LEFT JOIN OvertimeApproval a ON a.OvertimeApprovalID=t.OvertimeApprovalID
WHERE t.TimeClockEntryID IN(49436,49581)
ORDER BY t.TimeClockEntryID;
